Central Sydney · Haymarket, World Square, The Galeries, Clarence Street & Pitt Street Mall
After dropping bags in Balmain; route to choose

Monday 30 November 2026, after arrival and dropping bags in Balmain. Flexible timing; tentative outing for Henry and Max. Newtown · King Street vintage shopping & Continental Deli
King Street, Newtown · Continental Deli, 210 Australia St

Departs and returns Aquarium Wharf, Darling Harbour; transport to wharf to choose

Intended Thursday 3 December 2026: Golden Glow sunset cruise by Sea Sydney Harbour, for two. TENTATIVE / UNBOOKED; to pay. Departs and returns Aquarium Wharf, Darling Harbour. Duration: 90 minutes including boarding and disembarking. Evening departure slot not selected; any previously researched times are indicative only. Operator advertises A$75 per adult / A$150 for two, approximately NZ$184 at 1 AUD = 1.225 NZD. This is an advertised fare, not a 3 December checkout quote; verify date availability, final price and any booking fees before booking. Grazing platters and one drink each; extra drinks paid separately. Minimum passenger numbers require confirmation. Operator source: https://www.seasydneyharbour.com.au/golden-glow.html .
